description: This file contains test utility classes for SPDY stream testing, including delegate implementations for handling stream events and data.

classes.name: ClosingDelegate
classes.description: A delegate class for handling closing events of a SpdyStream.

classes.name: StreamDelegateBase
classes.description: Base class for stream event handling, managing stream state and callbacks.

classes.name: StreamDelegateDoNothing
classes.description: A delegate that performs no actions on stream events.

classes.name: StreamDelegateConsumeData
classes.description: A delegate that consumes all received data.

classes.name: StreamDelegateSendImmediate
classes.description: A delegate that sends data immediately upon headers reception.

classes.name: StreamDelegateWithBody
classes.description: A delegate that sends a predefined body when headers are received.

classes.name: StreamDelegateCloseOnHeaders
classes.description: A delegate that cancels the stream upon receiving headers.

classes.name: StreamDelegateDetectEOF
classes.description: A delegate that detects EOF when no more data is received.

methods.name: OnEarlyHintsReceived
methods.description: Called when early hints are received.

methods.name: OnClose
methods.description: Called when the stream is closed.

methods.name: CanGreaseFrameType
methods.description: Indicates if frame type can be greased.

methods.name: source_dependency
methods.description: Returns the source dependency for logging.

methods.name: WaitForClose
methods.description: Waits for the stream to close.

methods.name: TakeReceivedData
methods.description: Returns all received data as a string.

methods.name: GetResponseHeaderValue
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a response header.

methods.name: Cancel
methods.description: Cancels the stream with an error code.
